about_the_game:
🎥 Stream or Scream? 👻

Step into the role of a fearless streamer—always hidden behind a horse mask—as you explore Japan’s most haunted ruins in HAUNTED STREAMER, a single-player horror experience where every eerie moment is broadcast live.

Will you earn fame and fortune, or become just another missing person?
It's time to start your live stream.

Capture the Terror

Ghosts, vengeful spirits, and poltergeist activity lurk in the darkness.
Your job? Film everything.

The closer and longer you capture high-value footage, the more viewers you’ll attract.
Earn Likes and Super Coins by delivering the most chilling content.

But beware—some things are best left unseen.

Sanity vs. Success

The deeper you go, the more horrifying the encounters become.
Your sanity won’t last forever.

Witnessing too many paranormal events will break your mind.
If your sanity drops to zero… death awaits.

How far will you go for the perfect shot?
Can you balance fear and fame, or will the madness consume you?

Super Coin Challenges

Your audience craves danger.

Viewers will send real-time challenges during your stream.
Complete them for massive donations—but at what cost?

Some dares are harmless. Others… might be your last.

Live Streaming and Content Creation Policy

You are welcome to stream and create monetized content using this game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 (6 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
